zh-CN.title: 日期与广场搜索升级
items: 聊天记录日期选择固定为六周视图，并会依据实际记录范围展示可选日期
广场现支持关键词与年、月、日组合筛选，网页与小程序体验保持一致

en.title: Improved dates and Square search
items: Chat history calendars now use a consistent six-week view bounded by actual records
Square now supports combined keyword and year, month, or day filters across web and mini program
